title: Medical Staff Credentialing and Privileging
content:
SOP: Medical Staff Credentialing and Privileging (SOP-HR-001)
DEPARTMENT: Human Resources and Administration
VERSION: 2.2
ROLES: medical_superintendent, hr_officer
PURPOSE: Verify medical council registration and operative surgical scopes.
STEPS:
Step 1: Execute phase 1 of Medical Staff Credentialing and Privileging in full compliance with Human Resources and Administration hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 2: Execute phase 2 of Medical Staff Credentialing and Privileging in full compliance with Human Resources and Administration hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 3: Execute phase 3 of Medical Staff Credentialing and Privileging in full compliance with Human Resources and Administration hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 4: Execute phase 4 of Medical Staff Credentialing and Privileging in full compliance with Human Resources and Administration hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
Step 5: Execute phase 5 of Medical Staff Credentialing and Privileging in full compliance with Human Resources and Administration hospital policy, verifying patient UHID and audit stamps.
- [BLOCKER] System connectivity or missing documentation in Human Resources and Administration.
- [BLOCKER] Bed, reagent, medication, or personnel resource constraints during peak hours.
- [ESCALATION] Delays exceeding 2 hours must be escalated to the Operations Manager.
- [ESCALATION] Clinical complications or safety hazards must be escalated immediately to Clinical Review.
source_citation: SOP-HR-001 Medical Staff Credentialing and Privileging v2.2, Section 4
